instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\housing.dxf. Import housing.dxf. Draw a housing with outer rectangle (0,0)-(180,110), inner cavity rectangle (40,30)-(140,80), boss circles centered at (40,55) and (140,55) radius 18, four bolt holes radius 4 at (20,20), (160,20), (20,90), and (160,90), and text ACAD-31. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
